name: dex
description: Canonical Xian AMM contracts with an idempotent local bootstrap path and a demo XIAN/XDT pool.
use_case: Run the Xian DEX under known contract names so wallets, the SnakX web app, automation services, and integration tests can rely on the same AMM surface.

starter_flows.name: local
starter_flows.summary: Run a local indexed node, deploy the pinned DEX bundle, and seed a demo liquid pair for the DEX web app and automation tests.

steps.title: Create and start the local indexed node
notes: Run these commands from the xian-stack checkout.
The localnet-up-with-dex target starts the localnet and then deploys the pinned DEX bundle.

steps.title: Inspect the local DEX endpoints
notes: Run this command from the xian-stack checkout.
Use the reported RPC and indexed-read endpoints for the DEX web app and automation services.

starter_flows.name: remote
starter_flows.summary: Deploy a small shared network, then bootstrap the pinned DEX bundle against the service RPC with an explicit operator wallet.

steps.title: Create the shared-network bundle
commands: uv run xian network create dex-remote --template consortium-3 --chain-id dex-remote-1 --generate-validator-key
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
The consortium template is the recommended remote operator posture for a shared DEX network.

steps.title: Deploy and verify the remote nodes
notes: Run these commands from the xian-deploy checkout with your prepared inventory.
Use a service node for indexed reads, DEX web inspection, and automation services.

steps.title: Bootstrap the pinned DEX bundle
notes: Run this command from the xian-stack checkout.
For production-like deployments, configure real pairs and LP tokens explicitly instead of seeding the demo pool.
